description: This file defines a report module for the ERPNext system related to received items that are pending billing. It includes functions to build report columns, gather filtering arguments, and execute the report by fetching data from the non_billed_report module, returning columns and data for display.

methods.name: execute(filters=None)
methods.description: Main entry point of the report that returns columns and data by calling helper functions and fetching data based on filters.

methods.name: get_column()
methods.description: Returns the column definitions for the report, specifying labels, field types, options, and widths.

methods.name: get_args()
methods.description: Generates and returns a dictionary of arguments used to fetch report data, including filters like doctype, party, date, and sort order.
